title: Placement of Collateral Protection Insurance — Waiting Periods, Coverage Effective Date and Term
content:
## Clause 1 — Waiting periods

Collateral Protection Insurance coverage may be placed only when the placement date is at least the product's minimum period from the first lapse notice after the first lapse notice was mailed. That period is counted in calendar days from the mailing date of the record's latest first lapse notice, and placement exactly on the boundary qualifies.

Coverage may be placed only when the placement date is also at least the product's minimum period from the second lapse notice after the second lapse notice was mailed. This second period is counted in calendar days from the mailing date of the record's latest second lapse notice, and placement exactly on the boundary qualifies.

## Clause 2 — Further conditions

Placement requires that both notices were mailed for the current lapse, that no acceptable proof was verified after the first notice, and that the contract status is active.

## Clause 3 — Coverage effective date

The coverage effective date is the later of the lapse date and the placement date less the product's backdating limit in calendar days. Coverage is never backdated further, so no premium is ever charged for a day more than the backdating limit before the placement date.

## Clause 4 — Term, renewal and placement notice

Placement runs for the product's placement term and renews for another term on the same day unless acceptable proof is verified first; a renewal does not need new notices where the product so provides. A placement notice and certificate stating the effective date, plan, premium and deductible is mailed within the product's placement-notice period after placement.

## Worked judgement on hypothetical dates

Write F for the mailing day of the latest first lapse notice, S for that of the latest second lapse notice, A for the first-notice period and B for the second-notice period.

| Placement day | Placement day at least A after F? | At least B after S? | Waiting periods met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| exactly A after F, and later than B after S | yes (boundary) | yes | yes |
| one day short of A after F | no | yes | no |
| exactly B after S, and later than A after F | yes | yes (boundary) | yes |
| A after F, but one day short of B after S | yes | no | no |

**Effective date, hypothetical:** with a backdating limit of K days, a lapse date 10 days before placement gives an effective date 10 days before placement when 10 is no more than K; a lapse date further back than K days gives an effective date exactly K days before placement.
